'''Lubo''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] child who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Lubo was showing [[Numa/Legends|Numa]] and [[Unidentified Lethan Twi'lek girl|another friend]] a [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurr]] chick shortly before the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
